en: The postcard depicts a historic canal-side scene with medieval buildings typical of northern European architecture, featuring gabled roofs, brick façades, and a church tower in the background. The setting includes a canal with a metal railing along the street and reflections of the old buildings on the water. The card is in sepia tones, indicating it is likely vintage. There is French text at the bottom.
